picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four DOE Genesis Mission awards within a 300+ institution national AI-for-science initiative — a flagship federal bet on AI-accelerated research that signals where major science funding is headed.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant (part of a $60M investment) will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers — a rare case of AI research translating directly into large-scale humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's OpenAI partnership rolls ChatGPT Edu out to 80,000+ students and staff, one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, setting a template other universities will watch closely.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishes a dedicated AI and advanced analytics college at UNT, a major private investment that will fund endowed positions and reshape the university's AI research capacity.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky joins a DOE-selected national team on the 'Mine of the Future' initiative, linking AI research to critical-minerals infrastructure — a strategically significant government-academia-industry tie-up.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's new ETCRAM analog memory achieves 100x density gains over prior approaches, a hardware advance that could materially improve efficiency for AI-capable smart devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's disputed claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem, met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao, is a high-stakes test case for how far AI reasoning claims can be trusted.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and edit AI-generated 3D models for fabrication — a concrete step toward making generative 3D design actually usable.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, University of Queensland and industry partners makes AI data-centre GPU loads dynamically grid-responsive, directly addressing the energy strain AI infrastructure places on power grids.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing building marks tangible progress on a $40 million college launch, reflecting sustained institutional investment in AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building
